prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production mobile puppy diary UI sprite atlas. Create FOUR newly designed combination activity symbols in a strict 2 by 2 grid on a SQUARE canvas with genuinely transparent alpha background. Four equally sized square cells. Each single symbol centered at (25%,25%), (75%,25%), (25%,75%), (75%,75%) respectively. Each symbol occupies 68-72% of its own cell, with generous transparent gutters between cells. Exactly four unified single-piece objects. All symbols equal apparent visual weight, simple legible at 38px. No typography, numbers, labels, faces, emoji, outer panels or background. This is a NEW icon family extending the STYLE of the reference image (reference only, do not copy its three-cell layout). Combine concepts by drawing one integrated silhouette, NOT by putting separate old icons beside or on top of one another. Meaning and order: TOP LEFT pee + poop: a blue teardrop whose body curls into a warm ochre poop spiral, the blue outer sweep and ochre spiral interlock as one newly drawn rounded emblem. TOP RIGHT pee + eating: a green dog-food bowl whose left body sweeps into a blue teardrop contour, a blue enamel inset formed into the bowl front, and a few brown kibble pieces inside the rim; one continuous object. BOTTOM LEFT poop + eating: a green dog-food bowl with an ochre stylized spiral carved or painted directly into the broad front wall as part of the bowl design; simple kibble inside its rim, no actual poop inside the food. BOTTOM RIGHT pee + poop + eating: one green dog-food bowl whose front has an integrated blue teardrop-shaped inset with an ochre spiral formed into that inset; keep all three semantic colors and a simple strong silhouette, no extra detached parts. Combination symbols should be unmistakably distinct from one another, carefully art-directed emblems, not sticker collages. Do not add numeric count badges; the app adds those separately. Style PUPPY JOURNAL: warm hand-painted watercolor, softly irregular dark ink outlines, warm ivory paper edge, handmade adult diary cutouts. Cornflower blue #497AB9, warm ochre #A97037, leaf green #558351, offwhite #FFFDF4. Restrain pigment texture, slightly asymmetrical ceramic bowl shapes, 2D frontal illustration. Match the reference line weight and watercolor rendering. No shiny clay or wooden material.
